fixes.explanation: You got it, baker. The voice calls out, “Gabriel, explain the vision to this man.” Gabriel is an angel who stands in the presence of God (Luke 1:19). Daniel was watching and trying to understand, and here comes the one who will explain.
You got it, baker. Gabriel says, “…the large horn between his eyes is the first king.” So the big horn stands for a person, and the goat stands for the king of Greece.
